# Christopher Larsen, CPA

> A California CPA practice focused on small business accounting and tax, and personal
> tax preparation. For small businesses, bookkeeping, monthly close, financial statements,
> and federal and California business tax returns. For individuals, federal and California
> income tax returns, including rental and investment income. Additional services include
> real estate accounting, where the work centers on lease compliance reviews and CAM
> (common area maintenance) audits for commercial tenants, owners, and operators.
> Based in Southern California, licensed and serving clients statewide.

## Facts

- Principal: Christopher D. Larsen, CPA. California CPA license No. 151422.
- Prior firms: EY (strategy and management consulting) and Deloitte (accounting and
  advisory). No current employer is named on this site.
- Service area: California, statewide.
- Contact: connect@larsen-cpa.com. No street address is published.
- The practice does not publish client names, engagement results, or testimonials.

## Primary services

- Small business accounting: bookkeeping and monthly close, financial statements,
  federal and California business tax returns, payroll and 1099 coordination, and
  QuickBooks and Xero setup and cleanup.
- Personal tax preparation: federal and California individual income tax returns,
  multi-state returns, rental property income, self-employment income, and investment
  income and equity compensation.

## Additional services

- Real estate accounting: lease compliance and CAM audits for commercial tenants. The
  annual operating expense or CAM reconciliation a landlord issues is examined against
  the tenant's own lease and the supporting expense schedules. The output is a written
  memo in which each finding is tied to a specific lease provision and a specific
  supporting schedule. Items examined: overcharges, pro rata share errors, base year
  issues, expense cap violations, gross-up errors, and improperly billed capital costs.
- Lease accounting advisory: ASC 842 compliance, lease abstraction, lease accounting cleanup.
- Commercial lease audits beyond CAM: base rent verification, percentage rent audits.
- Landlord-side and property management accounting support.
- Expense reconciliation and financial cleanup for owners and operators.
- Entity selection and formation guidance, budgeting and forecasting, and special projects.
- Ad hoc CPA advisory for real estate transactions.

Engagements are scoped and priced on their own terms, fixed or hourly; work is not
always contingency-based, and no recovery amount is promised.
